Mengetahui tujuan bapa saudaranya ingin menjodohkannya bersama anak seorang pengurus bank untuk membiayai projeknya, Darus hilang membawa diri - tetapi bapa saudaranya mempunyai rancangannya yang tersendiri.

programme.title: Wanita Istimewa
programme.desc: Mirsa Alisia Rininta dan Radit Reuben Elishama hidup sederhana di Padang sehingga satu kesilapan besar berlaku apabila Radit tanpa sedar membawa beg berisi dadah. Untuk melindungi suaminya, Mirsa menyerah diri dan dipenjara selama tujuh tahun, manakala bayi yang dilahirkannya terpaksa diserahkan kepada ibu mertuanya untuk dijaga. Selepas dibebaskan, Mirsa mencari keluarganya tetapi mendapati Radit sudah berpindah ke Jakarta. Jejak itu membawa Mirsa ke sebuah acara pelancaran perumahan di mana dia bertemu semula dengan Radit yang kini bersama isterinya Karina Naomi Zaskia dan berkenalan dengan Reza Randy Pangalila, sementara tekanan daripada Pramana Adipura terhadap perkahwinan mereka mula terbongkar.

Defying the status quo in the fight for gender equality, they secretly form an alliance to protect other girls who fall victim to this. Unexpectedly, a group of wicked guys headed by butler NG SHEUNG-SHUN Louis Yuen bring in bandits for their own selfish motives. While blowing the girls cover, it also puts the relationship of SHUI-FUNG and KWAI-SZE to the test, escalating the feud between men and women

programme.desc: The beauty of folklore is all around us in Taiwan, but we often overlook it and fail to appreciate and feel it. The aim of this program is to promote the beauty of Taiwanese folklore and bring folklore to life. This program showcases folk culture regardless of race or religion, and presents travel information in a fun way, combining easy-to-understand folk culture knowledge with the mission of passing on folk culture. The audience can learn more about folk cultural products such as handicrafts, antiques, temple folklore, as well as short stories about the gods, and information about local tourism. It is an educational and entertaining way to travel and learn about folklore.

programme.title: Schemes in Antiques
programme.desc: Despite his familys expertise in ancient Chinese relics, Xu Yuan becomes an electronics shop owner to distance himself from his disgraced family. However, when an antique is to be returned to China, Xu Yuan uncovers an ancient mystery and soon embarks on a journey that can finally restore his familys reputation but may also cost him his life.

programme.title: Hail the Judge
programme.desc: A low level magistrate is run out of town for defending a beautiful murder suspect. Through a series of comedic events he ascends to the top rank returns looking for revenge.

programme.title: Tales from the Occult: Ultimate Malevolence
programme.desc: The final chapter of Tales From The Occult, the movie features three short stories about two high school friends, a magician undergoing hypnosis to find her missing friend, and a man finding his way out of a mysterious building. The stories reveal the most terrifying and ugly side of human nature, where life and death are just a thought away!

programme.title: Another Me
programme.desc: Constable Li Mao marries a rich girl but her parents disapprove of their marriage. One day, Li accidentally discovers that he looks exactly like the prince! While he aims to secure a high ranking position in the palace, the prince wants freedom, so they decide to switch identities. This however, got them both involved in the ministers conspiracy

programme.title: Detective vs. Sleuths
programme.desc: Hong Kong is rocked by a series of cold-blooded murders whose victims are runaway suspects of unsolved cases. The group of killers calls themselves The Chosen Sleuths. Former top detective Lee vows to bring the brutal killers to justice and prove himself to be the real Chosen Sleuth instead of a lunatic.

programme.title: Dumpling Queen, The
programme.desc: In the 1970s, Zang moves to Hong Kong with her two daughters following a failed marriage. Starting as a dishwasher and odd-job worker, she struggles to survive. With a family dumpling recipe, she sets up a stall at Wan Chai Pier and rises from a street vendor to the citys renowned Dumpling Queen.

programme.title: The Fierce Wife
programme.desc: An Zhen divorces her husband after his infidelity but faces a pivotal decision four years later - to return to her cheating husband and old life or to embark on a new life with a new love?

programme.title: The Sparring Partner
programme.desc: Adapted from a sensational 2013 parricide in Hong Kong, a young man partners with his friend to murder and dismember his parents. Pleading not guilty, the defendants play the devil and idiot game, while the defense attorneys turn on each other. Meanwhile, heated debates emerge inside the jury room, where nine jurors grapple with the truth.

programme.title: Unbeatable
programme.desc: Former world champion boxer Fai meets fiery young fighter Qi in Macau. As he mentors Qi for an upcoming MMA tournament, Fai rekindles his passion for fighting, life, and the people he cares about.

programme.title: The Way We Keep Dancing
programme.desc: This sequel of The Way We Dance features the plight of Hong Kongs grassroots performing artists as they fight against the governments plan to gentrify an industrial district where they settled in.

programme.title: Ne Zha 2
programme.desc: After surviving the Heavenly Lightning Strike, the souls of Ne Zha and Ao Bing persist, but their mortal forms lie in ruins. Master Tai Yi seeks to restore them using the Seven-Colored Lotus, yet countless perils loom over the process. As enemies close in and fate hangs in the balance, can they reclaim their bodies and rewrite their destiny?

programme.title: Call Me Agent
programme.desc: Miu Ling dreams of becoming a secret agent. Even though it seems impossible, she still harbours such a dream and hopes that it will soon come true. One day, Miu Ling rescues an injured secret agent who promises to make her his apprentice. From then on, her life is turned upside down and she goes onto a roller-coaster of madcap adventures.

programme.title: Dragon Tiger Gate
programme.desc: Adapted from a famous Hong Kong comic, Tiger Wong is ambushed after he unwittingly took the Lousha Plaque but is saved by his brother Dragon Wong. They also befriended Turbo Shek during the fight and the trio forms a brotherhood. To avenge the death of the Dragon Gate masters, they train and vow to defeat Shibumi, the leader of Lousha Clan.

programme.title: S Storm
programme.desc: ICAC Chief Officer Luk witnesses a suspects murder while investigating an illegal soccer gambling case, but is unable to disclose information to Chief Inspector Lau due to his code of confidentiality, thereby hindering Laus investigation. While starting the case with mutual distrust, they end up reaching a rapport to uproot the crime syndicate.

programme.title: Burning Stars
programme.desc: Set in 1920s Shanghai under the shadow of White Terror, agent Li Yi Min is tasked with escorting a key figure to safety. He reunites with former allies to break through deadly traps. Amid the turmoil, a group of idealistic youths join the cause, risking everything to uphold the mission and find courage in a time of chaos.

programme.title: Forbidden City Cop
programme.desc: A wild and hilariously anachronistic tale of an imperial guard of the Forbidden City who has no martial arts abilities. When the emperor is abducted, he saved the day with his unusual hobby: tinkering with futuristic inventions!

programme.title: Life Hotel
programme.desc: Once a gangster, Li struggles to find work to pay for his fathers heart surgery. To earn money, he goes undercover to help shut down Life Hotel for a redevelopment project, but gradually forms bonds with its residents. As Li discovers that the hotel serves as a home for the sick, he grapples with his sense of responsibility and empathy.

programme.title: Blades of the Guardians
programme.desc: Fugitive bounty hunter Dao Ma takes on a perilous escort mission across the desert to Changan. His charge is the empires most wanted man, drawing pursuit from all sides. As rival forces close in, Dao Ma is pulled into a conspiracy that threatens war between the imperial court and the martial world.

programme.title: Septet: The Story of Hong Kong
programme.desc: Seven of Hong Kongs most revered directors, all with distinctly unique styles, come together for the first time to compose a symphony of stories for their city from the 50s to the future.

programme.title: Born to Fly
programme.desc: Lei Yu has officially become the new generation of Chinese test pilots after rounds of strict selection. Captain Zhang Ting leads Lei Yu and other pilots to test the latest fighter jets. Lei Yu keeps pushing the limits in each test flight in the hope of coming up with the perfect plane to ensure the safety of the fighter pilots.

programme.title: Where The Wind Blows
programme.desc: Founded in the 70s, Hong Kongs ICAC is committed to fight corruption in the police force. Detectives Lui Lok and Nam Kong build a corruption system that creates conflicts between the triad and the police. When ICAC hunts down the two, their control finally comes to an end. Where the wind blows, Hong Kong is no longer what it used to be!

programme.title: YUM Investigation
programme.desc: YUM is a detective agency that handles supernatural cases. As YUM investigates the evil spirits appearing in an old building, they discover that the spirits are created by a spirit master to haunt the residents so that the building can be vacated for redevelopment. Can the YUM investigators finally find ways to fight against the master?

programme.title: The Dancing Millionairess
programme.desc: Peter was a key dancer in a dance troupe and applied to be the chauffeur of a rich girl, Betty. When he is rumoured to be her lover, Betty is furious and goes undercover as a reporter to investigate the rumour. They fall in love in the process, and after putting Peter through many tests, they finally seal their love with a dance.

programme.title: The Silent Swordsman
programme.desc: Young swordsman Shen Bing Yi is appointed leader of the Sun and Moon secret society, sworn to take down a traitorous general conspiring with foreign invaders. While fighting for his nation, he captures the hearts of a spirited female warrior and two beautiful Uyghur princesses, leaving him caught between his duty and their devotion.

programme.title: The Warlord
programme.desc: A bandit became a warlord in northern China by helping Russia fight against Japan. Due to his ignorance and silly behaviour, he is seen as a joke to everyone. The warlord is finally killed by the daughter of a troupe master whom he had killed for no reason, bringing a befitting end to a traitor.

programme.title: Tales Of A Eunuch
programme.desc: Wei Xiao Bao enters the palace and unexpectedly befriends Emperor Kang Xi. At the same time, he is assigned by a revolutionary group to steal the valuable Sutra of 42 Chapters, which Emperor Kang Xi himself is also seeking. Demonstrating keen intelligence, Xiao Bao deftly navigates between opposing factions and successfully evades danger.

programme.title: The Lotus Lamp
programme.desc: Linda Lin Dai plays both mother and son in this lavish fable about a goddess who falls in love with a mortal scholar Cheng Pei-pei in her debut role. Over two years in production, it was released on the first anniversary of Lindas tragic suicide.

programme.title: Challenge of the Gamesters
programme.desc: A master gambler and his partner are recruited to investigate a Shanghai tycoon suspected of using his casino as a front for espionage. As they enter the high-stakes gambling world, they must outwit a dangerous opponent in a deadly game of skill and deception.

programme.title: The Grand Substitution
programme.desc: In this Opera epic, a loyal Imperial Court servant gives up his own newborn son to save the prince from an evil official.

programme.title: The Grand Substitution
programme.desc: In this Opera epic, a loyal Imperial Court servant gives up his own newborn son to save the prince from an evil official.

programme.title: Heroes Shed No Tears
programme.desc: Kao Chien Fei is a young swordsman who wields a special sword with a teardrop marked on its blade. He is charged with averting an impending crisis in the martial arts world, but the villain, Zhou Tung Lai, wishes to become the ruler in the martial arts world, and launches a scheme to pit the various heroes against one another.

programme.title: Heroes Shed No Tears
programme.desc: Kao Chien Fei is a young swordsman who wields a special sword with a teardrop marked on its blade. He is charged with averting an impending crisis in the martial arts world, but the villain, Zhou Tung Lai, wishes to become the ruler in the martial arts world, and launches a scheme to pit the various heroes against one another.

programme.title: Spring Blossoms
programme.desc: Some of Shaw Brothers biggest female stars of the 1970s share the screen in this tale of young love and interfering parents, starring Lily Li, Shu Pei Pei and Essie Lin Chia.

programme.title: The Bride Napping
programme.desc: A rich girl Yue Ying, together with her maid Chun Lan, encounter a poor scholar Bian Ji at a fte. Chun Lan realizes Yue Ying is in love with him, but mixes his identity with a bandit due to an old servants confusion, threatening the couples union. After a series of complications, misunderstandings and mismatches, Chun Lan finally saves the day.

programme.title: The Heroic Ones
programme.desc: Set in the Tang Dynasty, the 13 adopted sons of Sha Tuo King are all renowned as royal warriors. David Chiang plays the 13th Prince, a powerful fighter whose prestigious status provokes jealously, leading to a gruesome family feud.

programme.title: Lovers Blades
programme.desc: The Lovers Blades, a pair of invincible weapons, are to be delivered to the Qing Emperor. However, they accidentally fell into the hands of Xiao Zhong Hui and Yuan Guan Nan, so Imperial Chief Zhuo Tian Xiong hunts them down for the blades. As the battle begins, the secret of the blades are also revealed.

programme.title: Vengeance Of A Snow Girl
programme.desc: A crippled woman seeks vengeance against the four men who killed her parents. However, when she crosses path with a young warrior who falls in love with her, trouble ensues as his father is one of the killers responsible for her familys massacre years ago.

programme.title: The House Of 72 Tenants
programme.desc: The 72 inhabitants of a dilapidated tenement live under the thumb of a heartless landlady and her sleazy husband. The arrival of a defiant new tenant however, changes their fate. The residents pool their resources together to prevent evictions, deflect targeted harassment by a corrupt policeman and ultimately prevent their home from being sold.

programme.title: Shaolin Hand Lock
programme.desc: Li Cheng Yings father was set up and killed by his old friend Ling Hao. Li, who has learnt Shaolin Hand Lock from his father, is on a mission to avenge his death. He works as an undercover guard at Lings house where he meets his long-lost brother, and the two team up to take revenge for their father against Ling.

programme.title: Fangs of the Cobra
programme.desc: Incredibly, the title serpent is not a harbinger of horror, but actually the films hero. This virtuous viper sniffs out bombs, fights gangs, battles a baby-killing rodent and even takes on a duplicitous woman. This one-of-a-kind thriller will be applauded by reptile fans everywhere.

programme.title: The Silver Fox
programme.desc: The formidable swordswoman Silver Fox was a child when her father was senselessly wounded by his step brother, and her mother raped. It is payback time eighteen years later, as her father trains her up with kung fu to take revenge on his behalf.

programme.title: Emperor Chien Lung
programme.desc: Emperor Chien Lung goes incognito to mix with his people and understand their needs. He encounters many strange things along the way, including being arrested and nearly beheaded. Who will save him?

programme.title: Chinatown Kid
programme.desc: After getting into trouble with a local gangster, Chui Ho, in Hong Kong, Tam Dong flees to San Francisco and manages to get a job in a restaurant in Chinatown. Tam Dong finds himself embroiled with the gangsters again in San Francisco, and has to fight Chui Ho when the two meet again...

programme.title: The Last Tempest
programme.desc: This sequel to The Empress Dowager continues the tale of Emperor Guangxu and Empress Dowager Cixi. Hosted by award-winning journalist and presenter Stephen Cole, The Agenda quite simply sets The Agenda . You wont find the same-old talking heads recycling platitudes instead thought-provoking guests to debate and explore key issues of todays world. Using virtual reality graphics to bring subjects to life, Stephen will navigate through subjects ranging from Prove That Climate Change Exists to Who Will Win the Race to Space. Opposing views will be given opportunity to flourish and develop into a meaningful conversation. The Agenda: No nonsense talk Challenging perceptions.

programme.title: When I was Your Age
programme.desc: Paul, 10, is a typical little boy. He goes to school, he plays sports, he is secretly in love, he tries to do as little as possible at home, he confuses his parents to get what he wants. And most of all, he would like them to finally understand that hes not a baby anymore and is old enough to do things ON HIS OWN!Except that... he has a strange gift... or curse... As soon as someone says the words, When I was your age... Paul is immediately hurled back to the time when the person he is talking to was 10 years old like he is now. He can shoot back 20, 30...70 years in time! Before mobile phones existed... When boys and girls didnt go to the same school... When there was only one television station... When toilets were at the far end of the yard... In other words, for a boy in 2021: ancient history! So as soon as he hears, When I was your age, gasp, gulp, where and when will he land this time? And in what completely crazy situation?

programme.desc: This follows one of Irelands bloodiest and most notorious crimes. On the 30th March 2005, police were called to the banks of Dublins Royal Canal after reports of body parts found floating in the water. Detectives arrived on the scene and began their investigation which brought them across the globe, and ultimately to the door of the Mulhall family. Linda and Charlotte Mullhall, dubbed the Scissor Sisters due to the barbarity of the crime, stabbed and dismembered their mothers partner, Farah Swaleh Noor and dumped his headless body into the canal. programme.title: When I was Your Age
programme.desc: Paul, 10, is a typical little boy. He goes to school, he plays sports, he is secretly in love, he tries to do as little as possible at home, he confuses his parents to get what he wants. And most of all, he would like them to finally understand that hes not a baby anymore and is old enough to do things ON HIS OWN!Except that... he has a strange gift... or curse... As soon as someone says the words, When I was your age... Paul is immediately hurled back to the time when the person he is talking to was 10 years old like he is now. He can shoot back 20, 30...70 years in time! Before mobile phones existed... When boys and girls didnt go to the same school... When there was only one television station... When toilets were at the far end of the yard... In other words, for a boy in 2021: ancient history! So as soon as he hears, When I was your age, gasp, gulp, where and when will he land this time? And in what completely crazy situation?

programme.desc: 經過名廚 Charmine 的嚴密指導之下，外表硬朗的三女之母陳太終於卸下心防，謙虛努力記住廚師的教導為了滿足三個女兒對她的期望，本來行街市都最怕魚檔的媽媽，終於決定挑戰自己對海鮮的恐懼，學習由醬油鮮蝦碌以及惹味蝦仁炒蛋組合而成的一蝦兩味而陳家三姊妹亦十分期待媽媽的學習成果，決定將家中年度大事阿媽家姐生日會，合併驗收晚飯，讓一家人跟主持們一同慶祝媽媽的生日以及廚藝的進步！為一向鬼主意多多的陳家三姊妹，除了合作搞大生日會之外，更與製作組合謀為媽媽送上一個快閃驚喜旅行，令一家人可以趁機傾吐心聲

programme.title: 貓之旅神

programme.title: 在絕版前放浪一次

programme.title: 超低能特攻隊

programme.title: 摔角魂
programme.desc: 職業摔角是一種以競技方式進行的表演藝術，過程充分展現摔角手在擂台上的拼勁及雄姿仿如真實的擂台格鬥，讓觀眾看得熱血沸騰各個國家的摔角表演，因應當地文化差異而有所不同，亞洲地區以日本摔角發展得最為蓬勃香港及台灣近年也發展得有聲有色，可謂後起之秀香港選手何顥麟更成功衝出亞洲，打到美國，正式成為世界摔角最高殿堂WWE的選手，在美國各地巡迴演出此節目的真正目的是透過香港摔角代表人物何顥麟及其團員，向廣大觀眾介紹，摔角到底是一種什麼表演藝術？如何由一名初哥變成擂台好手？過程以真人騷形式進行，再配以輕鬆搞笑的故事骨幹及旁白，深入淺出地介紹日本與香港之間的摔角文化及特色更會詳盡介紹摔角手鮮為人知的一面，擂台英姿訓練苦況日常生活...等等，務求全方化了解摔角，投入摔角

programme.title: 文藝誌

programme.title: 平行教室

programme.title: 環源基本步
programme.desc: Raymond 帶領義工團隊，透過社區活動將清潔處理的鞋子贈送予需要的小孩與老人他與多家大型企業合作，並在學校及公共場所設置回收箱形成了有效的回收系統，方便市民捐贈舊鞋，再發放給社群，延長鞋子的壽命，讓更多人受益

programme.title: 台灣山步行
programme.desc: 埔里素以四W聞名島，這令人自豪的四W，即是waterweatherwinewoman在這裡阿妹先來到飛行傘基地，從天空俯瞰山城之美，而刺激的過程也讓阿妹嚇的哇哇叫著陸之後，又在當地人的帶領之下，前往一處山林小溪，進行溯溪，一邊穿越激流，一邊在冰涼的溪水中玩樂，刺激好玩而且還能體驗，穿草鞋溯溪的特殊體驗晚上，還摸黑到一處山間小廟，參與一項神秘的祈福儀式，只要將鞭炮丟中廟內的金元寶，就能發財一整年，究竟阿妹能否幸運的擊中元寶，2020大發財呢?

programme.title: 終於飛到LA

programme.title: Dr.Any毛

programme.title: 老友記實用手冊
programme.desc: 不少長者面對哮喘的困擾，卻常誤以為是氣管老化而延誤治理本集邀請呼吸系統科專科醫生，深入剖析長者哮喘的成因與早期徵兆，分享日常避開致敏原的實用貼士

programme.title: 雙線運動人生
programme.desc: Peony，單線速度滾軸溜冰運動員，正職為公司業務發展副總監她每日處理繁忙商務工作，下班後仍穿上溜冰鞋，在場地高速滑行苦練起跑彎道及衝刺技術單線速度滾軸溜冰在香港屬小眾極限運動，講求極致速度平衡力與耐力Peony以專業態度與優異成績為港爭光作為高級管理層與運動員的雙重身份，她用實際行動證明：再忙碌的事業，都不能阻擋對夢想的追求

programme.title: 舔舔脷講講理
programme.desc: 水耕盆栽是一種以水為介質，讓植物根部直接浸於水中的耕種方式因為這種栽培方法不需要土壤，亦比較節省空間，近年十分受港人歡迎今日Vincent將會走入本地的城市水耕農場，訪問身體力行推動本地水耕的農場負責人，為舔舔脷．講講理講講將水耕落地的知識與理念

programme.title: 學神出沒注意
programme.desc: 今集學神出沒注意派出兩位愛鬥大的學神代表阿神及Leanne考牌！阿神處男下海為節目奉上人生第一次，Leanne則以低胸短裙迎戰地獄教車師傅！二人由筆試鬥到模擬測試，當中錯漏百出，水皮情況難分高下！見二人氣勢嚴重受挫，節目組特意安排神秘驚喜，家姐Ranya帶Leanne坐旅居車Camping；造星好兄弟Klau及Wallis則帶阿神夜遊車河，為二人學車打打氣！

programme.title: 聲的築城者

programme.title: 夜漫遊
programme.desc: Yoshi同Anton為咗食成都嘅隱世西班牙餐廳，竟然特登搭個幾鐘車，去到海拔超過1000米嘅龍泉山頂？之後Anton仲帶Yoshi去減肥，不過兩位唔係去做gym，而係去近年興起嘅室內場玩極限運動！Yoshi仲玩到嗌哂媽咪想提早放工？最後兩位仲搵到源於成都嘅正宗麻婆豆腐，一邊感受舌尖上嘅麻香，一邊欣賞川劇變臉同埋長嘴銅壺茶藝！

programme.title: 適者生存
programme.desc: 在一晚露宿野外的體驗後，女孩們對生火砍柴採集野菜熟練許多，特別是蔡宛珊更是精通生火，可以稱為這趟野外求生的火神，而米露迪製作的魚簍雖然只撈到了泥沙，但得到了教練稱讚製作的非常精緻，每個學員跟一開始什麼都不懂的自己比起來，都成長到能在不同的求生項目獨當一面，這次寶貴的野外求生經驗，讓女孩們留下深刻的回憶！

programme.title: 腦霧研究所
programme.desc: 相信對於男士嚟講，要分辨汽車嘅種類同性能絕對唔係難題，但今集腦霧研究所派出嘅三位挑戰者Shirley Kenji同Kaying都係無牌之人，對車嘅認識非常貧乏！三位要跟車行達人取經，並要進行一連串認車大考驗！除咗要認汽車儀表板警示之外，仲要學人聽引擎聲，仲有個第一個設有對話嘅NPC模擬情境題！希望三位可以順順利利過關啦！

programme.title: COLLAR智慧學園
programme.desc: COLLAR智慧學園終極決戰，對戰雙方實力旗鼓相當：一位喺節目初期，已經被譽為冠軍大熱門，之後就更加不負重望，以長勝姿態，過關斬將殺入決賽；另一位雖然因為最初表現失準而被淘汰，但係成功翻生之後就愈戰愈勇，堪稱敗者復活嘅傳奇！喺智慧嘅終極擂台上面，佢哋唔單止要鬥智鬥策略，仲要識捉心理同考勇氣！邊個信念唔夠強，隨時就將冠軍寶座拱手相讓！

programme.title: 駐港家鄉味
programme.desc: 一想起法國，就聯想到法式高級美食! 今集，法國駐香港總領事Christine，會帶同兩位主持去品嚐法國家鄉味道，感受法國菜的優雅情調與浪漫兩位主持絞盡腦汁，不甘示弱，帶領事去可能是香港最elegant的茶館，品嘗中式雅緻情懷

programme.title: 放學玩啲咩
programme.desc: 很多朋友認識跆拳道這種運動都是通過奧運會，但是你們又知不知跆拳道是在何時開始呢？跆拳道的基本裝備有哪些，一些基本動作又有哪些今集就帶大家了解跆拳道

programme.title: 大鳴大放
programme.desc: 大鳴大放是一個30分鐘的時事討論節目，識英雄重英雄，請來各界重磅名人，拋出論點，言無不盡，深入討論時事，跨越維港神州，宏觀全世界

programme.title: 經緯線
programme.desc: 香港非物質文化遺產清單有超過500個項目，處身轉變時代，不少面臨邊緣化，甚至失傳的危機位於上水古洞超過80年歷史的悅和醬園，主要製作傳統生曬豉油，這項釀造技藝於2014年被列入為香港非遺項目2011年，政府公布北部都會區發展策略，醬園廠房屬於發展區範圍，面臨收地問題，醬園負責人指，需要自行尋找合適土地搬遷，不過過程困難重重南音是廣東地區的傳統說唱曲藝，2014年被列入香港非遺清單，更是24個非遺代表作名錄之一；隨著娛樂多元化，南音的表演機會越來越少，有研究南音的學者認為，可以善用不同媒介推廣傳統表演藝術，例如電影破．地獄加入了南音元素，演唱客途秋恨和遊十殿，大眾會更容易認知和接受白鐵器具透過敲打折疊的方式，把鐵片緊密摺合，這項技藝同樣於2014年被列入為非遺項目白鐵防銹質量輕，而且價廉耐用，上世紀六七十年代是香港白鐵行業的黃金時期，不過隨著塑膠不鏽鋼等物料製品日漸普及，加上內地生產的家品輸入香港，本地白鐵製品需求不斷下降，有白鐵師傅便把這種傳統工藝，融合現代生活元素，製作有特色的日用品首飾和藝術裝置，爭取生存空間非遺項目要保育傳承，可以怎樣做？如何做？

programme.title: 一路camp 一路遊
programme.desc: 夜宿特色營房，眾人圍著溝火大玩煙花隔天親手採摘鮮甜玉米，並探訪精釀啤酒廠膽大主持更挑戰奇特草蜢雪糕！在前往第五個營地前，團隊特別到訪神祕的Zero磁場領域，吸滿大自然正能量

programme.title: 我想身體健康
programme.desc: 血友病的病人天生有凝血功能問題，到底他們的日常該如何護理？今集主持強尼米露迪Ash，找來Eric一起請教醫生！到底血友病能否醫治，患者又能如何應對？

programme.title: 爆谷一周
programme.desc: ViuTV 溫情劇日落下的彩虹用嶄新筆觸去紀錄社區重建前的最美餘光，因此今集請來導演劉偉恒與演員潘燦良阿Day（許軼），還有首度參演本台劇集的視后唐詩詠，在節目深情對話又激情討論劇集主打溫情，是否只剩既有套路暴走展開才是新出路？各台演員又是否自帶台風？妙語如珠，萬勿錯過！

programme.title: CHILL CLUB

programme.title: 蠟筆小新

programme.title: 隊長小翼第二季 青少年篇

programme.title: 꼬리에 꼬리를 무는 그날 이야기

programme.title: 터미네이터 2

programme.title: 범죄의 여왕
programme.desc: 범인은 이 안에 있어 나 촉 되게 좋아. 여자의 직감, 아줌마 파워, 남다른 촉이 발동한다!

programme.title: 패닉룸
programme.desc: 집안에 침입한 괴한들을 피해 패닉룸으로 숨어든 여자와 괴한들의 대결을 그린 스릴러 영화. 제목의 패닉룸은 위험한 상황에서 숨을 수 있도록 집안에 만든 안전한 비밀 방을 말한다. 집 안의 한정된 공간과 더 좁은 패닉룸이라는 공간 속에서 펼쳐지는 쫓고 쫓기는 이야기가 숨막히는 긴장감을 자아낸다. 등장인물들이 벌이는 치밀한 두뇌 게임도 멋진 볼거리가 된다. 뮤직비디오 감독으로 시작해 세븐으로 주목을 받게 된 데이빗 핀처 감독은 자신의 주특기인 어두운 분위기와 절묘한 영상미를 유감없이 발휘하고 있다. 벽을 통과하며 유유히 움직이는 카메라는 벽과 벽 사이에 갇힌 등장인물들을 비웃는 듯 하다. 미국 개봉시에도 첫주 흥행 1위를 차지하며, 평단과 관객 양쪽에서 좋은 반응을 얻었다. 오랜만에 주연을 맡은 조디 포스터는 임신한 몸으로 거친 액션까지 소화하며 좋은 연기를 선보였다. 본래 주연은 니콜 키드먼으로 내정되어 있었으나 나중에 조디 포스터로 교체되었다. 대신 짧게 목소리 출연을 한 키드먼을 만날 수 있다.

programme.title: 안시성
programme.desc: 우리는 물러서는 법을 배우지 못했다! 우리는 무릎 꿇는 법을 배우지 못했다! 우리는 항복이라는 걸 배우지 못했다!

programme.title: 진격의 거인 PART1

programme.desc: 우리 민족은 기록에 관해서는 대단한 저력을 지니고 있다. 유네스코에 세계문화유산으로 지정된 조선시대의 승정원일기가 그렇고 그 사초를 바탕으로 편찬한 조선왕조실록이 그렇다. 현대 의회 민주주의의 전당, 국회에도 이러한 기록에 있다. 국민의 대표기관인 국회의 의정활동을 낱낱이 기록하는 속기록이 바로 그것. 여의도 국회 30주년을 맞아 국회방송에서는 총 16부에 걸친 연작 다큐멘터리 다시보는 속기록연출 조정훈을 제작, 방송한다. 이 프로그램은 질곡의 대한민국 현대사를 국회 속기록이라는 프리즘을 통해 재조명하고, 우리에게 주는 질책과 교훈을 담아낼 계획이다.

programme.desc: 지우와 피카추는 오래된 전설이 있는 아름다운 마을 미케나에 도착한다. 먼 옛날, 포켓몬 아르세우스는 자신이 가진 생명의 근원으로 만든 생명의 보옥으로 미케나의 사람들을 도왔다. 다모스를 믿고 그에게 생명을 빌려준 것이다. 그런데 보옥을 돌려받기로 한 날, 다모스는 아르세우스를 함정에 빠뜨렸고 그의 분노는 현재까지 이어졌다. 지우와 피카추는 다모스의 배신에 얽힌 비밀을 밝혀내고 아르세우스의 분노를 잠재우기 위해 나선다.
